records.subject: Welcome aboard, Summit Analytics
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero activity: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and no reply to the welcome email [email:1654364e]. No tickets, so no signal of active engagement. 8 days left, but a fully silent first week makes unaided self-serve activation unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Summit Analytics' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Checking in after your first week with Wrenfield. Nothing has been set up on the account yet, so I wanted to make sure you're not stuck on anything.

Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how your team works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything about setup as we go.

Best,
Chidi
